description:
Get a grouped spending summary for tax reporting.

Expenses are money out (negative amounts) and income is money in, in dollars.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

group_by.description: Grouping: taxline, subcategory, category, month or account, or two joined by "+" (e.g. "category+month").

month.description: Only this month, as YYYY-MM; empty for the whole session.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

scope.description: Which categories to total: "tax" (Schedule C and Schedule A), "all" (everything except Duplicate), or one category: "Schedule C", "Schedule A", "Internal Transfer", "Personal" or "Duplicate". Anything else means "all".

session_id.description: TaxSort session id (the UUID string create_session returns; list_sessions lists yours).

name: taxsort_get_summary
title: Get the tax summary
